description: Source code for event management in an AUTOSAR OS implementation, including functions for waiting on events, setting events, getting event status, and clearing events for tasks.

methods.name: WaitEvent
methods.description: Blocks the calling extended task until at least one event in the specified mask is set, with checks for call level, task type, and resource occupation.

methods.name: SetEvent
methods.description: Sets specified events for a task identified by TaskID, potentially making it ready if it was waiting for those events, with validation for task ID, application ownership, and task state.

methods.name: GetEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the current event mask of a specified task, with validation for task ID, task type, and suspension state.

methods.name: ClearEvent
methods.description: Clears specified events of the calling extended task, with validation for call level and task type.
